searchText: What is the latest document containing the full fast confirmation rule and it's full proof of validity? also what' s the status of checking the compatibility with ePBS? cc <@390327547038007297> <@425572898787426305> I asked that a couple months back and was pointed of this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00549 It's algo 5 / section 4 the afety and monotonicity proofs references to section 3 I have not reviewed the proof, but prysm already has this implemented and testing by running on my home server, that's hooked to a Arbitrum one nitro node following the live feed to see how often it reorgs I have not implemented the latest spec (changes to unrealized justification tracking and start from there etc)

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
I asked that a couple months back and was pointed of this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00549
It's algo 5 / section 4
the afety and monotonicity proofs references to section 3
I have not reviewed the proof, but prysm already has this implemented and testing by running on my home server, that's hooked to a Arbitrum one nitro node following the live feed to see how often it reorgs

I have not implemented the latest spec (changes to unrealized justification tracking and start from there etc)
